answers.reason: Accepted: 安らかに is an adverb describing how they go on smiling, and the ledger keeps 安らかさ (peace) distinct from 安息 (rest). Using at {t:rest} here blurs that distinction.
Accepted: 深い安らかさ is the recurring peace chord from p3, not the 安息 of p17. Rendering it as peace preserves the ledger distinction.

notes: Removed {t:rest} token from both 安らかに and 安らかさ instances to reserve it for 安息 in p17 per ledger.
data.revised_english: It was in a dim light, and, quiet like that light, three people drawing close with heads together, telling a long story. The story seemed to go on and on between them, for so long without ever breaking off. And in that story, all the good and evil of the world, sadness and suffering and anger and anguish and joy, everything seemed to be told. But teller and listener only quietly, peacefully, went on smiling, and they did not move at all. With heads bent and eyes lowered, only a quiet nostalgia and forgiveness seemed to wrap them there. And there too a deep, deep peace showed over all of them.
data.say: Accepted both queries to keep peace distinct from rest.
